title: Light in the Darkness
question: Today, can a doctor hand over a life to settle a question?

hearth_council.described: The first-floor sitting-room of 221B Baker Street, 1881: two broad sash windows in the FAR wall over Baker Street, a black iron grate under a white marble mantelpiece in the LEFT wall, the panelled door to the landing in the RIGHT wall, a red patterned Turkey carpet, buff striped wallpaper, a horsehair sofa along the near RIGHT wall, two worn armchairs at the hearth, a deal side table carrying a rack of test tubes and a spirit lamp, bookshelves flanking the chimney breast. The two worn armchairs stand at the hearth with a low deal table between them carrying a tumbler on its side in a wet ring, a third upright chair drawn up from the wall, and the white morning light of an April day comes flat through the two sash windows and a small coal fire burns red in the black grate
hearth_council.landmark: the white marble mantelpiece over the black grate
hearth_council.landmark_size: is the height of a hand
hearth_council.route: from the hearth rug at the grate back across the room to the sofa arm
hearth_council.geometry: The two worn armchairs hold the CENTRE and RIGHT of frame at the height of a seated man, the white marble mantelpiece stands across the TOP LEFT at the height of a standing man's shoulder with the black grate under it, the low deal table with the overturned tumbler stands at the CENTRE at the height of a seated man's knee, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM of frame

halliday_corridor.described: The second-floor corridor of Halliday's Private Hotel, Little George Street, 1881: a short narrow passage with a worn drugget runner over bare boards, dull green painted walls, one panelled bedroom door in the FAR wall with a white china handle, a sash window at the near end giving grey morning light down the passage, and a single gas bracket burning low on the LEFT wall
halliday_corridor.landmark: the panelled bedroom door at the end of the passage
halliday_corridor.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
halliday_corridor.route: from the head of the stairs along the drugget runner to the bedroom door
halliday_corridor.geometry: The panelled bedroom door stands in the FAR wall at the CENTRE of frame at the height of a standing man and a half, the worn drugget runner runs away from the BOTTOM of frame to the door, the dull green walls close in at both edges, and the gas bracket burns at the LEFT at the height of a standing man's head

stangerson_room.described: A small second-floor bedroom at Halliday's Private Hotel, 1881: a sash window standing wide open in the FAR wall with grey morning light and the mews roofs beyond it, an iron bedstead along the LEFT wall with its sheets thrown back, a plain deal washstand under the window carrying a china basin, an upright chair beside the bed with a pipe on its seat, bare boards, and pale distempered walls
stangerson_room.landmark: the open sash window in the far wall
stangerson_room.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
stangerson_room.route: from the broken bedroom door across the bare boards to the open window
stangerson_room.geometry: The open sash window stands in the FAR wall at the CENTRE of frame from the TOP edge down to the height of a man's hip with grey morning light through it, the iron bedstead runs along the LEFT wall at the height of a man's knee, the deal washstand with its china basin stands under the window at the RIGHT of CENTRE, and the bare boards hold the BOTTOM

mews_lane.described: The cobbled mews lane behind Halliday's Private Hotel, early morning, 1881: a narrow service lane of wet grey cobbles between the soot-brick back wall of the hotel on the LEFT and a row of low stable doors on the RIGHT, a wooden ladder raised against the hotel wall to an open second-floor window, a milk churn standing by a stable door, and the first thin daylight coming down the lane from the far end
mews_lane.landmark: the wooden ladder raised against the hotel wall
mews_lane.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
mews_lane.route: from the mouth of the lane along the wet cobbles to the foot of the ladder
mews_lane.geometry: The wooden ladder stands against the soot-brick wall at the LEFT of CENTRE reaching from the BOTTOM of frame to the open window at the TOP, the wet grey cobbles run away down the CENTRE of frame, the low stable doors stand along the RIGHT edge at the height of a standing man, and thin daylight comes from the far end of the lane
mews_lane.crowd: one boy of about twelve with a milk can walks the lane at a normal walking pace, and a stable cat sits on an upturned crate

hearth_dog.described: The first-floor sitting-room of 221B Baker Street, 1881: two broad sash windows in the FAR wall over Baker Street, a black iron grate under a white marble mantelpiece in the LEFT wall, the panelled door to the landing in the RIGHT wall, a red patterned Turkey carpet, buff striped wallpaper, a horsehair sofa along the near RIGHT wall, two worn armchairs at the hearth, a deal side table carrying a rack of test tubes and a spirit lamp, bookshelves flanking the chimney breast. The hearth rug lies before the black grate with a worn cushion set down on it, the low deal table carries a wine glass, a saucer, a small white chip ointment box and an open penknife, and the white morning light of an April day comes flat through the two sash windows and a small coal fire burns red in the black grate
hearth_dog.landmark: the white marble mantelpiece over the black grate
hearth_dog.landmark_size: is the height of a hand
hearth_dog.route: from the sofa arm across the red carpet to the hearth rug at the grate
hearth_dog.geometry: The hearth rug holds the BOTTOM CENTRE of frame with a worn cushion set down on it, the black iron grate stands beyond it at the CENTRE at the height of a seated man's knee with the white marble mantelpiece above, the low deal table with the wine glass and the white chip box stands at the LEFT at the height of a seated man's knee, and the red Turkey carpet runs to both edges

landing_arrest.described: The first-floor sitting-room of 221B Baker Street, 1881: two broad sash windows in the FAR wall over Baker Street, a black iron grate under a white marble mantelpiece in the LEFT wall, the panelled door to the landing in the RIGHT wall, a red patterned Turkey carpet, buff striped wallpaper, a horsehair sofa along the near RIGHT wall, two worn armchairs at the hearth, a deal side table carrying a rack of test tubes and a spirit lamp, bookshelves flanking the chimney breast. A small leather portmanteau stands open on the red carpet before the panelled landing door with its straps loose, a pair of steel handcuffs lies on the deal side table, and the white morning light of an April day comes flat through the two sash windows and a small coal fire burns red in the black grate
landing_arrest.landmark: the open panelled door to the landing
landing_arrest.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
landing_arrest.route: from the hearth rug across the red carpet to the open landing door
landing_arrest.geometry: The small leather portmanteau stands open on the carpet at the CENTRE of frame at the height of a man's knee, the open panelled door to the landing stands beyond it at the RIGHT at the height of a standing man and a half, the white marble mantelpiece is at the LEFT edge, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM of frame

shots.frame: Insert straight down on the low deal table between the two worn armchairs: a cut-glass tumbler lying on its side in a spreading wet ring of whiskey, a dead cigar lying across the deal beside it, an open box of cigars with its lid back at the far edge, and the red Turkey carpet out of focus beyond the table.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the fallen tumbler across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; Gregson's hand comes into the frame and rights the glass; his fingers turn the glass a thumb's width on the deal; the dead cigar rolls a thumb's width where his cuff brushes it; his hand comes back off the deal toward the bottom of frame.
shots.camera: over the low deal table between the two worn armchairs, level with a seated man's knee and a forearm above the table top, looking straight down at the deal, an 85mm lens. The white morning light falls across the table from the two sash windows at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A cut-glass tumbler lies on its side at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height in a spreading wet ring, a dead cigar lies across the deal beside it at the RIGHT, an open cigar box stands at the TOP LEFT, and the red Turkey carpet is out of focus beyond the table edge
shots.turn: a man in triumph -> a man knocked out of it
shots.why: Gregson sprang out of his chair and upset his whiskey. The upset glass IS the news landing, and it costs no face and no line to say so.

shots.frame: Close on Holmes standing at the mantelpiece, bare-headed, clean-shaven, the bottle-green velvet jacket open over his white shirt, his lips pressed thin and his brows drawn down over his eyes.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his head comes round to the door; his mouth opens on the line; his shoulders come round after it.
shots.camera: at the near armchair, level with a standing man's eyes and two long strides from him, an 85mm lens. The white morning light falls on one side of his face from the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: A clean-shaven man's head fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a bottle-green velvet shoulder under it, his brows are drawn down, the white marble mantelpiece edge crosses behind him at the height of his own shoulder, and the buff striped wallpaper stands beyond
shots.turn: a case closed -> a case reopened

shots.frame: Medium of Lestrade taking the upright chair: a little lean man with a sallow thin face and wavy chestnut hair, his charcoal frock coat disarranged, sitting down heavily, with Watson beyond him on the sofa arm in a grey tweed waistcoat, his thin waxed moustache dark on his sunburnt face.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back from the chair across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; Lestrade sits down and his shoulders come down; Watson's head turns from him to the hearth.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a seated man's eyes and three long strides from the upright chair, a 35mm lens. The white morning light comes from the windows at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A little lean man sits on an upright chair at the CENTRE of frame at three quarters of the frame height with a sallow face under wavy chestnut hair, a man in a grey tweed waistcoat sits on the sofa arm beyond him at the RIGHT at half the frame height, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: two rivals -> a council of war

shots.frame: Medium close of Lestrade in the upright chair, a sallow thin rat-like face, dark eyes set close under a low brow, wavy chestnut hair, his soft collar askew above the charcoal frock coat, one hand flat on his knee.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a hand's breadth to the left across the whole shot; his chin comes up from his collar; his hand turns over on his knee.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a seated man's eyes and two long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white morning light falls across his face from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A little lean man's head and chest fill the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a sallow face and wavy chestnut hair, his soft collar stands askew at his throat above the charcoal frock coat, one hand rests flat on his knee at the BOTTOM of frame, and the buff striped wallpaper is behind him
shots.turn: a man withholding -> a man telling it

shots.frame: Wide down the second-floor corridor of Halliday's Private Hotel: a short narrow passage, a worn drugget runner over bare boards, dull green walls, one panelled bedroom door standing shut at the far end with a white china handle, grey morning light from the sash window at the near end.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in down the corridor across the whole shot, travelling four long strides; the low gas flame on the LEFT wall leans and steadies; the drugget runner comes up past the bottom of frame.
shots.camera: at the head of the stairs, level with a standing man's chest and five long strides from the bedroom door, a 35mm lens. The grey morning light comes from the sash window behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A panelled bedroom door stands shut at the CENTRE of frame at the height of a standing man and a half with a white china handle, a worn drugget runner runs away down the CENTRE of the bare boards, dull green walls close in at both edges, and a gas bracket burns low at the LEFT at the height of a man's head
shots.turn: a room in Baker Street -> the place it is about
shots.why: Lestrade's account is a speech containing the Boots's account containing the milk boy's. Three removes made episode 6's flattest stretch. Cut to the place instead.

shots.frame: Insert low on the bare boards at the foot of the bedroom door: a thin red ribbon of blood curling out from under the door across the drugget runner and pooling along the skirting at the far side.
shots.motion: The camera tilts down a hand's breadth across the whole shot; the ribbon of blood creeps a thumb's width further along the skirting; the gaslight shifts once across the wet.
shots.camera: at the corridor floor, level with the skirting board and a forearm from the door, a 50mm lens. The low gas flame is the only light and it comes from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: The bottom edge of a panelled door crosses the TOP of frame, a thin red ribbon of blood comes out from under it at the CENTRE at the width of a finger and runs across the drugget to a small pool at the skirting at the BOTTOM RIGHT, and the bare boards hold the rest
shots.turn: a locked door -> what is behind it

shots.frame: Medium of Lestrade at the bedroom door, a little lean man with a sallow face and wavy chestnut hair, his shoulder set against the panel and both hands flat on the wood, the white china handle beside his fist.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the door across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; his shoulder drives forward into the panel; the door swings in away from him.
shots.camera: in the corridor behind him, level with a standing man's chest and two long strides from the door, a 35mm lens. The low gas flame comes from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A little lean man stands at the RIGHT of CENTRE at four fifths of the frame height with his shoulder set against a panelled door and both hands flat on the wood, the white china handle is at the CENTRE at the height of his own hip, and the drugget runner holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a door held -> a door given

shots.frame: Wide of the small bedroom from the broken door: the sash window standing wide open in the far wall with grey light and the mews roofs beyond, an iron bedstead along the LEFT with its sheets thrown back, a deal washstand under the window, and a man huddled on the boards beneath the sill in a white nightdress.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in from the doorway across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the curtain at the open window lifts and falls once in the draught; the thrown-back sheet stirs at the bed's edge.
shots.camera: in the broken doorway, level with a standing man's chest and five long strides from the window, a 28mm lens. The grey morning light comes through the open window at the CENTRE
shots.at_rest: An open sash window stands at the CENTRE of the FAR wall from the TOP of frame down to the height of a man's hip with grey light through it, a man in a white nightdress lies huddled on the bare boards beneath it at a third of the frame height, an iron bedstead runs along the LEFT wall with its sheets thrown back, and the bare boards hold the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a man expected -> a man found

shots.frame: Close on the dead man's face against the bare boards: a fair-haired man about forty with a narrow clean-shaven face the colour of tallow, his eyes half open and dull, the collar of his white nightdress at his throat.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a hand's breadth to the right across the whole shot; the grey window light travels across his cheek as the camera moves; the loose collar of the nightdress lifts once at his throat.
shots.camera: at the boards beside him, level with the floor and a forearm from his head, an 85mm lens. The grey morning light comes from the open window at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A clean-shaven man's face fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height lying against bare boards with the eyes half open and dull, the collar of a white nightdress stands at his throat at the BOTTOM of frame, and the boards run away behind his head
shots.turn: a suspect -> a second victim

shots.frame: Medium of the wall above the bedstead: bare distempered plaster with the word RACHE standing on it in five rough capitals of dried blood, the iron bed head below and the thrown-back sheet.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the word across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; the grey window light crosses the plaster as the camera comes in; the loose sheet lifts once at the bed head in the draught.
shots.camera: at the foot of the iron bedstead, level with a seated man's eyes and three long strides from the wall, a 35mm lens. The grey morning light comes from the open window at the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: Bare distempered plaster fills the frame with the word RACHE standing across the CENTRE in five rough capitals of dried blood at the height of a hand, the iron bed head crosses the BOTTOM of frame, and a thrown-back white sheet lies under it
shots.turn: one murder -> the same hand twice
shots.why: The word is the only thing tying the two rooms together, and it is the one piece of text this pipeline has drawn legibly before (episode 3).

shots.frame: Full of the mews lane behind the hotel at first light: wet grey cobbles between the soot-brick back wall on the LEFT and low stable doors on the RIGHT, a wooden ladder raised against the brick to an open second-floor window, a milk churn by a stable door.
shots.motion: The camera tracks down the lane to the left across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; a boy with a milk can walks the cobbles at a normal walking pace; a stable cat drops off its crate and crosses behind him.
shots.camera: at the mouth of the lane, level with a standing man's chest and four long strides from the ladder, a 35mm lens. The first thin daylight comes down the lane from the far end
shots.at_rest: A wooden ladder stands against the soot-brick wall at the LEFT of CENTRE reaching from the BOTTOM of frame to an open window at the TOP, wet grey cobbles run away down the CENTRE, low stable doors stand along the RIGHT edge at the height of a standing man, and a boy with a milk can stands at the BOTTOM RIGHT at a third of the frame height
shots.crowd: one boy of about twelve carries a milk can down the lane at a normal walking pace, and a stable cat sits on an upturned crate
shots.turn: a locked room -> a way out of it

shots.frame: Medium up the wooden ladder against the soot-brick wall: the rungs going up out of frame to the open second-floor window, the wet brick either side, the first daylight on the top rungs.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the open window at the top of the ladder across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; the curtain inside the window lifts once in the draught; the same draught drags it back against the sash.
shots.camera: at the foot of the ladder, level with a standing man's chest and a long stride from the wall, a 35mm lens. The first thin daylight comes down the lane from behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A wooden ladder runs up the CENTRE of frame from the BOTTOM to the TOP against wet soot-brick, an open sash window stands at the TOP CENTRE at the height of two hands with a curtain inside it, and the brick wall fills both edges
shots.turn: a witness -> a route

shots.frame: Insert on the deal washstand under the open window: a china basin holding water red-brown, a folded sheet laid beside it with two dark wiped streaks across the linen, and a small white chip ointment box standing on the sill above.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the basin across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; the grey window light moves across the water as the camera comes in; the curtain edge lifts once above it.
shots.camera: at the washstand, level with a man's hip and a forearm from the basin, an 85mm lens. The grey morning light comes through the open window from above
shots.at_rest: A china basin holding red-brown water stands at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height, a folded white sheet with two dark wiped streaks lies beside it at the LEFT, a small white chip box stands on the window sill above at the height of a thumb, and the deal top holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a man who ran -> a man who washed and stayed

shots.frame: Medium close of Holmes risen out of the armchair, bare-headed, clean-shaven, the bottle-green velvet jacket open, a small white chip ointment box held up between finger and thumb with the small white sticking plaster on his forefinger.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on Holmes across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his hand carries the white box up to the height of his own eyes; his chin comes up with it.
shots.camera: at the sofa arm, level with a standing man's eyes and two long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white morning light falls across his face from the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: A clean-shaven man's head and chest fill the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height in an open bottle-green velvet jacket, a small white chip box is held between finger and thumb at the height of his own chin with a small white sticking plaster on the forefinger, and the buff striped wallpaper is behind
shots.turn: a tangle -> the last link

shots.frame: Full of Watson coming in at the landing door with an old terrier carried in both arms, bare-headed, his thin waxed moustache dark on his sunburnt face, a grey tweed waistcoat, the dog's snow-white muzzle over his forearm.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back from the door across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; Watson carries the dog forward across the carpet at a normal walking pace; the dog's head turns once against his sleeve.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a standing man's chest and four long strides from the landing door, a 35mm lens. The white morning light comes from the windows at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A man in a grey tweed waistcoat stands at the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height carrying an old terrier in both arms at the height of his own waist, the dog's snow-white muzzle lies over his forearm, the open panelled door stands behind him at the RIGHT, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a theory -> a life fetched to test it
shots.why: This is the one chapter in Part One where Watson's profession is used and the one thing he does with his own hands. It is the episode's only chance at a protagonist.

shots.frame: Insert on the low deal table: a wine glass holding a teaspoonful of water, an open penknife beside it, and a small white chip box with one pearl-grey pill cut in two halves on the deal.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the wine glass across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; a bare hand comes in and drops a half pill into the water; the fingers turn the glass a thumb's width.
shots.camera: over the low deal table, level with a seated man's knee and a forearm above the table top, an 85mm lens. The white morning light falls across the glass from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A wine glass holding a teaspoonful of water stands at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height, an open penknife lies beside it at the RIGHT, a small white chip box with two half pills stands at the LEFT at the height of a thumb, and the deal top holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a pill -> a question put to it

shots.frame: Medium of the hearth rug: an old terrier lying on a worn cushion before the black grate with its snow-white muzzle down and its flank rising and falling, a saucer of milk set down on the rug a hand's breadth from its nose.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the dog across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; the dog's head comes up off the cushion to the saucer; its tongue goes to the milk.
shots.camera: at the sofa arm, level with the hearth rug and three long strides from the cushion, a 35mm lens. The red firelight comes from the grate at the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: An old terrier lies on a worn cushion at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height with its snow-white muzzle down, a white saucer stands on the rug a hand's breadth from its nose at the RIGHT, the black iron grate is beyond at the TOP RIGHT, and the hearth rug holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a saucer set down -> a saucer taken

shots.frame: Close on Holmes standing over the rug with a watch open in his palm, bare-headed, clean-shaven, the bottle-green velvet at his shoulder, his lip caught between his teeth.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his eyes come down from the watch to the rug; his free hand drums once on his thigh; his shoulders come down.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a standing man's eyes and two long strides from him, an 85mm lens. The white morning light falls on one side of his face from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A clean-shaven man's head fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a bottle-green velvet shoulder under it, an open watch lies in his palm at the BOTTOM of frame at the height of a hand, and the buff striped wallpaper stands behind him
shots.turn: certainty -> a man watching a clock
shots.why: The first time in seven episodes Holmes is publicly wrong, and the two detectives are enjoying it. Hold on his face and let the silence be the beat.

shots.frame: Medium close of Lestrade in the upright chair with one ankle crossed over his knee, a sallow thin face under wavy chestnut hair, the charcoal frock coat open, the beginning of a smile at one corner of his mouth.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a hand's breadth to the right across the whole shot; his head turns to the other chair; his crossed foot comes down to the carpet.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a seated man's eyes and two long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white morning light falls across his face from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A little lean man sits at the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a sallow face under wavy chestnut hair, one ankle is crossed over his knee at the BOTTOM of frame, the charcoal frock coat hangs open, and the buff striped wallpaper is behind him
shots.turn: a rival corrected -> a rival enjoying it

shots.frame: Medium close of Holmes's two hands over the deal table, the small white sticking plaster on the right forefinger, the open penknife in one fist and the white chip box held down under the other, the bottle-green velvet cuffs above them.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his hands across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; the knife hand comes down and splits the second pill on the deal; his other hand sweeps the halves toward the glass.
shots.camera: across the low deal table, level with a standing man's waist and two long strides from his hands, a 50mm lens. The white morning light falls across the deal from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: Two bare hands fill the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height over a deal table, an open penknife stands in the right fist at the height of a hand with a small white sticking plaster on the forefinger, a small white chip box is held down under the left hand at the LEFT, bottle-green velvet cuffs cross the TOP of frame, and the deal top holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a failed test -> the other half of it

shots.frame: Close on the old terrier's head on the worn cushion, its snow-white muzzle along the cushion's edge and one grey brow over a half-closed eye, the red firelight low across the wiry coat, the black grate out of focus beyond.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the muzzle across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; the wiry coat goes still along the ribs; the coal burns on in the grate behind it.
shots.camera: on the hearth rug itself, level with the cushion and a forearm from the dog's head, an 85mm lens. The red firelight comes low from the grate at the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: An old terrier's head fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height lying on a worn cushion with a snow-white muzzle along the cushion's edge and one grey brow over a half-closed eye, the red firelight lies low across the wiry coat, and the black grate stands out of focus beyond at the TOP RIGHT
shots.turn: a question -> its answer, paid for
shots.why: The chapter kills the dog on screen. Doyle's Watson does not describe the body; the camera stays on the cushion and the grate and lets the stillness say it, the way episode 6's shot 18 kept the camera off the wrist.

shots.frame: Medium close of Holmes at the mantelpiece, bare-headed, clean-shaven, the bottle-green velvet jacket open over his white shirt, his head sunk on his chest and his brows drawn down.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a hand's breadth to the left across the whole shot; his head comes up off his chest; his shoulders come round to the room; his hand comes out of his jacket pocket and opens at his side.
shots.camera: at the near armchair, level with a standing man's eyes and two long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white morning light falls across his face from the RIGHT
shots.at_rest: A clean-shaven man's head and chest fill the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height in an open bottle-green velvet jacket, the white marble mantelpiece edge crosses behind him at the height of his own shoulder, and the buff striped wallpaper stands beyond
shots.turn: pressed -> answering

shots.frame: Full of the open landing door with a ragged boy's head round the jamb: a boy about thirteen with a sharp freckled face under tangled sandy hair and a torn brown jacket, one hand at his forelock, the dim stairhead behind him.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the doorway across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the boy's hand comes down off his forelock to his side; his head turns back to the stair.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a boy's eyes and four long strides from the landing door, a 35mm lens. The white morning light comes from the windows at the LEFT and the stairhead stands dim beyond him
shots.at_rest: A ragged boy's head and shoulder stand round the door jamb at the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a sharp freckled face under tangled sandy hair, one hand is up at his forelock at the height of his own temple, the open panelled door stands round him, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a council -> a cab at the door

shots.frame: Medium of the carpet before the landing door: Holmes down on one knee over a small open leather portmanteau with a strap in both hands, and a tall cabman come forward beside him in a long brownish coat, his weathered red face turned down to the buckle.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the two men across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the cabman puts his hands down to the strap; Holmes's head comes further down over the buckle.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a kneeling man's chest and four long strides from the portmanteau, a 35mm lens. The white morning light comes from the windows at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A man in a bottle-green velvet jacket kneels at the LEFT of CENTRE at half the frame height over a small open leather portmanteau with a strap in both hands, a tall man in a long brownish coat stands beside him at the RIGHT at four fifths of the frame height with his hands coming down to the strap, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a man helping -> a man within reach

shots.frame: Close on Lestrade standing over the two men, a sallow thin rat-like face with dark eyes set close under a low brow and wavy chestnut hair, his soft collar askew above the charcoal frock coat, a pair of steel handcuffs held out flat on his open palm.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his open palm comes up into the bottom of frame with the handcuffs on it; his mouth opens on the line.
shots.camera: at the hearth rug, level with a standing man's eyes and two long strides from him, an 85mm lens. The white morning light falls on one side of his face from the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A little lean man's head fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a sallow face and wavy chestnut hair, his soft collar stands askew at his throat, an open palm holds a pair of steel handcuffs at the BOTTOM of frame at the height of a hand, and the buff striped wallpaper is behind him
shots.turn: a man hunted -> a man in the room
shots.why: The world's answer, in the mouth of a man with no idea he is giving it. He says they only need to find the man to put them on, and the man is on the floor beside his boot.

shots.frame: Insert on the carpet at the portmanteau: a tall man's bare wrist held down over the open buckle with a steel handcuff closed round it, the second ring hanging open, a long brownish cuff pushed back above it.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the wrist across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth; the open ring of the handcuff swings a thumb's width on its hinge; the brown cuff comes up over the steel.
shots.camera: at the carpet beside the portmanteau, level with the floor and a forearm from the wrist, an 85mm lens. The white morning light comes from the windows at the LEFT
shots.at_rest: A bare wrist lies across the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height with a steel handcuff closed round it and a second ring hanging open below, a long brownish cuff is pushed back above the steel at the LEFT, the open leather portmanteau stands beyond at the TOP, and the red Turkey carpet holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: the end of a little mystery -> a man who has not said why
shots.why: The chapter ends on Holmes naming him. That is the lead's line and it would be the fourth lead-button in five episodes. The click is the event; the name can wait for the picture, and leaving the WHY open is what makes episode 8 survivable.
